confusables.note: املای نزدیک؛ quaint یعنی کهنه و دلنشین (مثل خانه‌ای قدیمی و بامزه)، نه ترسیدن.

homograph.note: The verb (to flinch in fear) and the noun (a game bird) share only a spelling and have unrelated origins. Only the verb was tested; a hint must state which sense it targets.

senses.definition: to feel or show fear, so that you hesitate or draw back from something frightening

examples.en: The young soldiers quailed at the sound of distant artillery.
examples.fa: سربازان جوان از صدای توپخانه دوردست از ترس عقب کشیدند.

senses.definition: a small brown bird with a short tail, shot for sport or for food

examples.en: A pair of quail ran across the path and vanished into the grass.
examples.fa: دو بلدرچین از عرض مسیر دویدند و در میان علف‌ها ناپدید شدند.
